# McStas instrument file for ToF spectrometer

# Define parameters
lambda0 = 5.0
Pulse_width = 2.857e-3
Num_pulses = 1
GUI_start = 2.0
FO1_DIST = 6.0
L_ballistic_begin = 19.5
L_ballistic_end = 17.0
Length = 100.0
SAMPLE_DIST = 1.2
DETECTOR_DIST = 4.0
GUI_h = 0.105
GUI_w = 0.1
GUI_GAP = 0.05
H1 = 0.167
W1 = 0.116
H2 = 0.185
W2 = 0.15
H3 = 0.19
W3 = 0.15
H4 = 0.213
W4 = 0.14
H_chop = 0.075
W_chop = 0.03
H_end = 0.042
W_end = 0.0215
ALPHA = 3.4
M = 3.5
F_slow1 = 16.6667
F_slow2 = 0
F_fast1 = 0
F_fast2 = 200
N_fast = 1
SLOW1_THETA = 120
FO3 = 1
THETA_fast1 = 180
FAST_THETA = 5
Gamma = 0
Etun = 1
V_HOLE = 0
FRAC_QUASIEL = 0
FRAC_TUNNEL = 0
TT = 50
RES_DE = 0.5
cold = 0.95

# Constants and derived quantities
FREQ = ESS_SOURCE_FREQUENCY
t_offset = Pulse_width/2.0 + 170e-6
t_FO1 = FO1_DIST*lambda0/(2*PI*K2V) + t_offset
t_FO2 = Length/2*lambda0/(2*PI*K2V) + t_offset
t_fast1 = (Length/2 + 0.1)*lambda0/(2*PI*K2V) + t_offset
t_fast2 = Length*lambda0/(2*PI*K2V) + t_offset
t_fast2a = (Length + GUI_GAP)*lambda0/(2*PI*K2V) + t_offset
t_fast3 = (Length + 2*GUI_GAP)*lambda0/(2*PI*K2V) + t_offset
t_sample = (Length + SAMPLE_DIST)*lambda0/(2*PI*K2V) + t_offset
t_detector = (Length + SAMPLE_DIST + DETECTOR_DIST)*lambda0/(2*PI*K2V) + t_offset
tmin_zoom = t_fast2*1e6 - 1e3
tmax_zoom = t_fast2*1e6 + 1e3
E_target = VS2E*(K2V*2*PI/lambda0)*(K2V*2*PI/lambda0)

# Define components
source = ESS_butterfly
Origin = Progress_bar
TOFmoderator_zoom = TOF_monitor
TOFmoderator = TOF_monitor
Lmon_guistart = L_monitor
Lmon_normalize = L_monitor
Guide1 = Guide
Lmonslow1 = L_monitor
PSDslow1 = PSD_monitor
FOchop1 = DiskChopper
TOFLmon1 = TOFLambda_monitor
Lmon_afterslow1 = L_monitor
PSD_afterslow1 = PSD_monitor
Guidelong1 = Guide
Guidelong1b = Guide
Lmon_slow2 = L_monitor
FOchop2 = DiskChopper
Fastchop1 = DiskChopper
PSD_afterslow2 = PSD_monitor
Lmon_afterslow2 = L_monitor
TOFL_afterslow2 = TOFLambda_monitor
Guidelong2 = Guide
Lmon_beforeballistic = L_monitor
PSD_beforeballistic = PSD_monitor
Guidelong2a = Guide
Lmonfast2 = L_monitor
Lmonfast2_zoom = L_monitor
TOFLfast2 = TOFLambda_monitor
TOFLfast2zoom = TOFLambda_monitor
PSDfast2 = PSD_monitor
Fastchop2 = DiskChopper
Fastchop2counter = DiskChopper
FOchop3 = DiskChopper
TOFfast2_zoom = TOF_monitor
Lmon_afterfast2 = L_monitor
TOFL_afterfast2 = TOFLambda_monitor
TOFL_afterfast2_zoom = TOFLambda_monitor
PSD_afterfast2 = PSD_monitor
Guidesample = Guide
Lmon_guideend = L_monitor
PSDsample = PSD_monitor
TOFsample_zoom = TOF_monitor
Esample = E_monitor
Lmon_sample_zoom = L_monitor
sample = Tunneling_sample
detectorarm = Arm
TOFdetector = TOF_monitor
TOFdetector_zoom = TOF_monitor
Edetector = E_monitor
TOF2Edetector = TOF2E_monitor

# Define the instrument
instrument ToF_spectrometer

# Source
source AT [0, 0, -0.1] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: sector="W", beamline=5, cold_frac=cold, target_index=6, dist=GUI_start, focus_xw=GUI_w, focus_yh=GUI_h, Lmin=4.9, Lmax=5.1, n_pulses=Num_pulses

# Origin
Origin AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE Origin

# TOF moderator zoom
TOFmoderator_zoom AT [0, 0, 1E-6] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: nt=1000, filename="TOFmoderator_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.12, yheight=0.12, tmin=0, tmax=5000, restore_neutron=1

# TOF moderator
TOFmoderator AT [0, 0, 1E-6] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: nt=1000, filename="TOFmoderator.dat", xwidth=0.12, yheight=0.12, tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, restore_neutron=1

# L monitor at GUI start
Lmon_guistart AT [0, 0, GUI_start - 2e-6] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: nL=200, filename="Lmon_guistart.dat", xwidth=GUI_w + 0.01, yheight=GUI_h + 0.01, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# L monitor for normalization
Lmon_normalize AT [0, 0, GUI_start - 1e-6] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: nL=2880, filename="Lmon_guistart_normalize.dat", xwidth=0.10, yheight=0.10, Lmin=0, Lmax=20

# Guide1
Guide1 AT [0, 0, GUI_start] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: w1=GUI_w, h1=GUI_h, w2=W1, h2=H1, l=FO1_DIST - GUI_start - GUI_GAP/2, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003

# L monitor after slow1
Lmonslow1 AT [0, 0, FO1_DIST - 2e-6] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: nL=200, filename="Lmonslow1.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.21, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# PSD monitor after slow1
PSDslow1 AT [0, 0, FO1_DIST - 1e-6] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: filename="PSDslow1.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25

# FOchop1
FOchop1 AT [0, 0, FO1_DIST] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: theta_0=SLOW1_THETA, radius=0.6, yheight=0.20, nu=F_slow1, nslit=1, delay=t_FO1

# TOFL monitor after slow1
TOFLmon1 AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE FOchop1
    parameters: nL=200, nt=200, tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, filename="TOFLmon1.dat", xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.21, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# L monitor after slow1
Lmon_afterslow1 AT [0, 0, 2e-6] RELATIVE FOchop1
    parameters: nL=200, filename="Lmon_afterslow1.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.21, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# PSD monitor after slow1
PSD_afterslow1 AT [0, 0, 3e-6] RELATIVE FOchop1
    parameters: filename="PSD_afterslow1.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25

# Guide long1
Guidelong1 AT [0, 0, GUI_GAP/2] RELATIVE FOchop1
    parameters: w1=W1, h1=H1, w2=W2, h2=H2, l=L_ballistic_begin + GUI_start - FO1_DIST - GUI_GAP/2, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003

# Guide long1b
Guidelong1b AT [0, 0, L_ballistic_begin + GUI_start] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: w1=W2, h1=H2, w2=W3, h2=H3, l=Length/2 - L_ballistic_begin - GUI_start - GUI_GAP/2, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003

# L monitor after slow2
Lmon_slow2 AT [0, 0, Length/2 - 1e-6] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: nL=200, filename="Lmon_slow2.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# FOchop2
FOchop2 AT [0, 0, Length/2] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: theta_0=155, radius=0.6, yheight=0.6, nu=F_slow2, nslit=1, delay=t_FO2

# Fastchop1
Fastchop1 AT [0, 0.1, Length/2 + GUI_GAP] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: theta_0=THETA_fast1, radius=0.5, yheight=0.5, nu=F_fast1, nslit=N_fast, delay=t_fast1

# PSD monitor after slow2
PSD_afterslow2 AT [0, -0.1, 1e-6] RELATIVE Fastchop1
    parameters: filename="PSD_afterslow2.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25

# L monitor after slow2
Lmon_afterslow2 AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE PSD_afterslow2
    parameters: nL=200, filename="Lmon_afterslow2.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# TOFL monitor after slow2
TOFL_afterslow2 AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE Lmon_afterslow2
    parameters: nL=200, nt=200, tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, filename="TOFL_afterslow2.dat", xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# Guide long2
Guidelong2 AT [0, -0.1, GUI_GAP/2] RELATIVE Fastchop1
    parameters: w1=W3, h1=H3, w2=W4, h2=H4, l=Length/2 - 2*GUI_GAP - L_ballistic_end, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003

# L monitor before ballistic
Lmon_beforeballistic AT [0, 0, Length/2 - 2*GUI_GAP - L_ballistic_end + 1e-6] RELATIVE Guidelong2
    parameters: nL=200, filename="Lmon_before_ballistic.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# PSD monitor before ballistic
PSD_beforeballistic AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE Lmon_beforeballistic
    parameters: filename="PSD_beforeballistic.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25

# Guide long2a
Guidelong2a AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE PSD_beforeballistic
    parameters: w1=W4, h1=H4, w2=W_chop, h2=H_chop, l=L_ballistic_end, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003

# L monitor after fast2
Lmonfast2 AT [0, 0, L_ballistic_end + 1e-6] RELATIVE Guidelong2a
    parameters: nL=200, filename="Lmonfast2.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# L monitor fast2 zoom
Lmonfast2_zoom AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE Lmonfast2
    parameters: nL=200, filename="Lmonfast2_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.18, Lmin=lambda0 - 0.2, Lmax=lambda0 + 0.2

# TOFL monitor after fast2
TOFLfast2 AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE Lmonfast2_zoom
    parameters: nL=200, nt=200, tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, filename="TOFLfast2.dat", xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# TOFL monitor fast2 zoom
TOFLfast2zoom AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE TOFLfast2
    parameters: nL=200, nt=200, tmin=tmin_zoom, tmax=tmax_zoom, filename="TOFLfast2_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=lambda0 - 0.2, Lmax=lambda0 + 0.2

# PSD monitor after fast2
PSDfast2 AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE TOFLfast2zoom
    parameters: filename="PSDfast2.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25

# Fastchop2
Fastchop2 AT [0, 0.04, Length] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: theta_0=FAST_THETA, radius=0.35, yheight=0.35, nu=F_fast2, nslit=N_fast, delay=t_fast2

# Fastchop2 counter
Fastchop2counter AT [0, 0.04, Length + GUI_GAP] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: theta_0=FAST_THETA, radius=0.35, yheight=0.35, nu=-F_fast2, nslit=N_fast, delay=-t_fast2a

# FOchop3
FOchop3 AT [0, 0.04, Length + 2*GUI_GAP] RELATIVE Origin
    parameters: theta_0=2*FAST_THETA, radius=0.35, yheight=0.35, nu=F_fast2/FO3, nslit=N_fast, delay=t_fast3

# TOF fast2 zoom
TOFfast2_zoom AT [0, -0.04, 1e-6] RELATIVE FOchop3
    parameters: nt=100, filename="TOF_fast2.dat", xwidth=1.1, yheight=1.2, tmin=1e6*t_fast3 - 2e2, tmax=1e6*t_fast3 + 2e2

# L monitor after fast2
Lmon_afterfast2 AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE TOFfast2_zoom
    parameters: nL=500, filename="Lmon_afterfast2.dat", xwidth=0.06, yheight=0.12, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# TOFL monitor after fast2
TOFL_afterfast2 AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE Lmon_afterfast2
    parameters: nL=200, nt=200, tmin=0, tmax=3.0e5, filename="TOF_afterfast2.dat", xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# TOFL monitor after fast2 zoom
TOFL_afterfast2_zoom AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE TOFL_afterfast2
    parameters: nL=200, nt=200, tmin=tmin_zoom, tmax=tmax_zoom, filename="TOF_afterfast2_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.05, yheight=0.12, Lmin=lambda0 - 0.2, Lmax=lambda0 + 0.2

# PSD monitor after fast2
PSD_afterfast2 AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE TOFL_afterfast2_zoom
    parameters: filename="PSD_afterfast2.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25

# Guide sample
Guidesample AT [0, 0, GUI_GAP/2] RELATIVE PSD_afterfast2
    parameters: w1=W_chop, h1=H_chop, w2=W_end, h2=H_end, l=SAMPLE_DIST - 4*GUI_GAP, R0=1, alpha=ALPHA, m=M, W=0.003

# L monitor at guide end
Lmon_guideend AT [0, 0, SAMPLE_DIST - 4*GUI_GAP + 1e-6] RELATIVE Guidesample
    parameters: nL=1000, filename="Lmon_guideend.dat", xwidth=W_end + 0.01, yheight=H_end + 0.01, Lmin=0, Lmax=Lmax + 1

# PSD monitor at sample
PSDsample AT [0, 0, SAMPLE_DIST - 3*GUI_GAP + 1e-6] RELATIVE Lmon_guideend
    parameters: filename="PSDsample.dat", xwidth=0.1, yheight=0.25

# TOF sample zoom
TOFsample_zoom AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE PSDsample
    parameters: nt=500, filename="TOF_sample.dat", xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.04, tmin=1e6*t_sample - 5e4, tmax=1e6*t_sample + 5e4

# E monitor at sample
Esample AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE TOFsample_zoom
    parameters: nE=400, filename="Esample", xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.04, Emin=E_target - RES_DE, Emax=E_target + RES_DE

# L monitor sample zoom
Lmon_sample_zoom AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE Esample
    parameters: nL=100, filename="LMON_sample_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.04, Lmin=lambda0 - 0.1, Lmax=lambda0 + 0.1

# Sample
sample AT [0, -0.04, SAMPLE_DIST] RELATIVE Fastchop2
    parameters: thickness=0.01 - V_HOLE, radius=0.01, p_interact=1, f_QE=FRAC_QUASIEL, f_tun=FRAC_TUNNEL, gamma=Gamma, E_tun=Etun, focus_xw=0.015, focus_yh=0.015, yheight=0.04, target_index=2

# Detector arm
detectorarm AT [0, 0, 0] RELATIVE sample
    parameters: theta=TT, phi=0, psi=0

# TOF detector
TOFdetector AT [0, 0, DETECTOR_DIST] RELATIVE detectorarm
    parameters: nt=512, filename="TOF.dat", xwidth=0.015, yheight=0.015, tmin=0, tmax=2e5

# TOF detector zoom
TOFdetector_zoom AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE TOFdetector
    parameters: nt=100, filename="TOF_zoom.dat", xwidth=0.015, yheight=0.015, tmin=1e6*t_detector - 10e2, tmax=1e6*t_detector + 10e2

# E detector
Edetector AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE TOFdetector_zoom
    parameters: nE=400, filename="Edet", xwidth=0.015, yheight=0.015, Emin=E_target - RES_DE, Emax=E_target + RES_DE

# TOF2E detector
TOF2Edetector AT [0, 0, 1e-6] RELATIVE Edetector
    parameters: nE=200, filename="TOF2E.dat", xwidth=0.015, yheight=0.015, Emin=E_target - RES_DE, Emax=E_target + RES_DE, T_zero=t_sample, L_flight=DETECTOR_DIST

# End of instrument
end_instrument

# Run the instrument
run
    parameters: ncount=1e6, seed=123456789, wait_s=0
    output: "monitor_results.txt"
end_run
```
